fields.name: verify_token
fields.description:
### Checks if a token is not expired and correct.

    *Note that this is not for refresh tokens.*

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.description:
### refreshToken to generate a new login token:

    *Use this only if `JWT_LONG_RUNNING_REFRESH_TOKEN` is True*

    using the refresh-token you already got during authorization, and
    obtain a brand-new token (and possibly a new refresh token if you
    revoked the previous). This is an alternative to log in when your
    token expired.

fields.name: revoke_token
fields.description:
### Suspends a refresh token.

    *token must exist to be revoked.*

fields.name: register
fields.description:
Register user with fields defined in the settings. If the email field of
    the user model is part of the registration fields (default), check if there
    is no user with that email.

    If it exists, it does not register the user, even if the email field
    is not defined as unique (default of the default django user model).

    When creating the user, it also creates a `UserStatus` related to
    that user, making it possible to track if the user is archived /
    verified.

    Send account verification email.

    If allowed to not verified users login, return token.

fields.name: update_account
fields.description:
Update user model fields, defined on settings.

    User must be verified.

fields.name: password_change
fields.description:
Change account password when user knows the old password.

    A new token and refresh token are sent. User must be verified.

fields.name: password_reset
fields.description:
Change user password without old password.

    Receive the token that was sent by email.

    If token and new passwords are valid, update user password and in
    case of using refresh tokens, revoke all of them.

    Also, if user has not been verified yet, verify it.

fields.name: password_set
fields.description:
Set user password - for password-less registration

    Receive the token that was sent by email.

    If token and new passwords are valid, set
    user password and in case of using refresh
    tokens, revoke all of them.

    Also, if user has not been verified yet, verify it.

fields.name: create_event
fields.description:
Create any event. Must specify rule (and possibly sub-rule & serie-type) for correct validation/creation
        Shoot'n Score It support lots and lots of sports and code have both for historical reasons and
        for logical reasons, as some sports are dialects of each other, overloaded several sport on
        same models. For example IpscMatch if used for IPSC, USPSA & SRA as these all are closely related.

        The following is a listing of with each model and sport supported in hierarchy and also exactly which
        rules and sub-rules that they use.

        This is also a listing that can be used when generating search or create-event logic.

            CmpMatch - Civilian Markmanship Program rule:cm

                    CMP Issued Rifle A Match         rule: cm, sub_rule: rga
                    CMP Issued Rifle B Match         rule: cm, sub_rule: rgb
                    CMP M1 Carbine Match             rule: cm, sub_rule: rm1
                    CMP Vintage Sniper Match         rule: cm, sub_rule: rvs
                    CMP Rimfire Sporter Match         rule: cm, sub_rule: rrf
                    CMP 3-Gun Match                 rule: cm, sub_rule: r3g
                    CMP 4-Gun Match                 rule: cm, sub_rule: r4g
                    CMP Issued Pistol Match         rule: cm, sub_rule: hgp


                GenericMatch (a generic match - only used for registrations/sqaudding and not scoring, no sport really)

                    NTSA Match                     rule:nt, sub-rule:nm


                IdpaMatch - mainly for IDPA but also SADPA & ICORE

                    IDPA Handgun Match              rule: 'id', sub_rule:'hg'
                    IDPA Classifier Match        rule: 'id', sub_rule:'hg', classifier='handgun'
                    IDPA PCC Classifier Match    rule: 'id', sub_rule:'hg' , classifier=pcc
                    IDPA DMG Match                rule: 'id', sub_rule:'dmg'

                    SADPA MPD Handgun            rule: 'is', sub_rule:'hg'
                    SADAP MPD Rifle                rule: 'is', sub_rule:'rf'
                    SADPA MPD Shotgun            rule: 'is', sub_rule:'sg'
                    SADPA MPD Multi-platform    rule: 'is', sub_rule:'mp'

                    ICORE Match                    rule: 'ir', sub_rule: 'hg'
                    ICORE 4-Gun Tactical        rule: '4g', sub_rule:'dmg'


                IpscMatch - for IPSC but also USPSA, SRA, 3-Gun and SivilPistol

                    IPSC Handgun        rule: ip, sub-rule: nm, firerams: hg
                    IPSC Rifle            rule: ip, sub-rule: nm, firerams: rf
                    IPSC Mini Rifle        rule: ip, sub-rule: nm, firerams: mr
                    IPSC Shotgun        rule: ip, sub-rule: nm, firerams: sg
                    IPSC Air            rule: ip, sub-rule: nm, firerams: ai
                    IPSC PCC            rule: ip, sub-rule: nm, firerams: pc
                    IPSC Tournament        rule: ip, sub-rule: to, firearms:'rf,sg,hg'

                    Sivil Pistol match        rule: si, sub-rule: nm, firearms: hg

                    USPSA Handgun            rule: us, sub-rule: nm, fireams hg
                    USPSA Rifle                rule: us, sub-rule: nm, fireams rf
                    USPSA Precision Rifle    rule: us, sub-rule: nm, fireams pr
                    USPSA Shotgun            rule: us, sub-rule: nm, fireams sg
                    USPSA Multigun            rule: us, sub-rule: to, fireams rf,sg,hg # this can then be changed when creating a tournament

                    3-Gun Match                rule: 3g, sub-rule: to, fireams: 'rf,sg,hg'

                    SRA Match                rule: sr, sub-rule: to, fireams: 'rf,sg,hg'


                NordicMatch - used for Clay-shooting, SPSF sports like Fältskytte and Resul.fi sports

                    Fältskytte match                rule: nd, sub_rule: pf
                    Poäng-fältskytte match            rule: nd, sub_rule: hf
                    Magnumfält match                rule: nd, sub_rule: mf
                    Magnumprecisionskytte match        rule: nd, sub_rule: mp
                    Precisionsskytte match            rule: nd, sub_rule: pr
                    Snabbmatch                        rule: nd, sub_rule: sm
                    Militär Snabbmatch                rule: nd, sub_rule: ms

                    COMPAK sporting match            rule: 'cl', sub_rule: 'CPK'
                    Sporting match                    rule: 'cl', sub_rule: 'FSP'
                    English Sporting match            rule: 'cl', sub_rule: 'ESP'

                    Resul 300m Traditional Rifle    rule: rl, sub_rule: r3p
                    Resul 150m Traditional Rifle     rule: rl, sub_rule: r1a
                    Resul 150m Traditional Rifle    rule: rl, sub_rule: r1k
                    Resul 300m RA1 Rifle            rule: rl, sub_rule: r11
                    Resul 300m RA2 Rifle            rule: rl, sub_rule: r12
                    Resul 25m RA3 Pistol            rule: rl, sub_rule: p23
                    Resul 25m RA4 Pistol            rule: rl, sub_rule: p24
                    Resul 25m Scholastic Pistol        rule: rl, sub_rule: p2u
                    Resul 25m Traditional Pistol    rule: rl, sub_rule: p2o
                    Resul 50m Traditional Pistol    rule: rl, sub_rule: p5e
                    Result 25m Fast-pistol            rule: rl, sub_rule: p2p


                PpcMatch

                    PPC Match                     rule: pp, sub_rule: wa
                    PPC Shotgun March            rule: pp, sub_rule: sg


                PrecisionMatch

                    PRS Match                   rule: ps, sub_rule: prt
                    PRS Points Match            rule: ps, sub_rule: prp

                    Note - Precison Matches are also included under a NRA Series (but created / managed under this then and never standalone)


                SassMatch - used only for SASS matches

                    SASS main-match                rule: ss, sub_rule: mm
                    SASS side-match                rule: ss, sub_rule: sm
                    SASS Longrange match        rule: ss, sub_rule: lr
                    SASS Mounted match            rule: ss, sub_rule: mt


                SteelMatch - used for Steel Challenge, NSSD and ISSA Match

                    Steel Challenge match            rule: sc
                    ISSA match                        rule: ia
                    NSSF match                        rule: ns


                IpscSerie

                    IPSC Cup                    serie_type:'cp',  rule: 'ip'
                    IPSC League                    serie_type:'lg', rule: 'ip'
                    IPSC Grand Tournament        serie_type:'gt', rule: 'ip'

                    USPSA Cup                    serie_type:'cp', rule: 'us'
                    USPSA League                serie_type:'lg', rule: 'us'
                    USPSA Tournament            serie_type:'gt', rule: 'us'

                    3-Gun Cup                    serie_type:'cp', rule: '3g'
                    3-Gun League                serie_type:'lg', rule: '3g'

                    SRA Cup                        serie_type:'cp', rule: 'sr'
                    SRA League                    serie_type:'lg', rule: 'sr'


                NordicSerie

                    Fältskytte cup                    serie_type: cp, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: pf
                    Poäng-fältskytte cup            serie_type: cp, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: hf
                    Magnumfält cup                    serie_type: cp, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: mf
                    Magnumprecisionskytte cup        serie_type: cp, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: mp
                    Precisionsskytte cup            serie_type: cp, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: pr
                    Snabbmatch cup                    serie_type: cp, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: sm
                    Militär Snabbmatch cup            serie_type: cp, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: ms

                    Fältskytte league                serie_type: lg, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: pf
                    Poäng-fältskytte league            serie_type: lg, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: hf
                    Magnumfält league                serie_type: lg, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: mf
                    Magnumprecisionskytte league    serie_type: lg, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: mp
                    Precisionsskytte league            serie_type: lg, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: pr
                    Snabbmatch league                serie_type: lg, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: sm
                    Militär Snabbmatch league        serie_type: lg, 'rule:' nd, sub_rule: ms

                    COMPAK sporting cup                serie_type:'cp', rule: 'cl', sub_rule:'SPx'
                    Sporting cup                    serie_type:'cp', rule: 'cl', sub_rule:'TRx'
                    English Sporting cup            serie_type:'cp', rule: 'cl', sub_rule:'SKx'

                    COMPAK sporting cup                serie_type:'lg', rule: 'cl', sub_rule:'SPx'
                    Sporting cup                    serie_type:'lg', rule: 'cl', sub_rule:'TRx'
                    English Sporting cup            serie_type:'lg', rule: 'cl', sub_rule:'SKx'



                PpcSerie

                    PPC Cup                            serie_type:'cp' 'rule:' pp
                    PPC League                        serie_type:'lg' 'rule:' pp


                PrecisionSerie

                    PRS Cup                            serie_type:'cp', rule:'ps', sub_rule: 'prs'
                    PRS League                        serie_type:'lg', rule:'ps', sub_rule: 'prs'

                    NRA Cup                            serie_type:'cp', rule:'nr'
                    NRA League                        serie_type:'lg', rule:'nr'
                    NRA Tournament                    serie_type:'to', rule:'nr'

types.name: GroupNode
types.description:
Group Node
        All of SSI has an RBAC system in the backend that can be re-used for matches and organizations. This means that every event or org has a Group associated with it where users can be added/removed in this group and be assigned as Admin (do everything), Staff (do a little less but still update and change things) and Assistants (less, e.g. only enter scores).
        This means for someone to enter scores (and be allowed to do this over GQL) they will need to be admin/staff or assistant in a group assigned to this event.
        Groups can then be Permanent meaning they can be reused (not needing to create it again for your club) for a new event, or an existing event changed to use this group.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional `specifiedByURL`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.
